scenes.title: Rampur, Drawing Room
narration: *{{playerName}}, tum aaj apne parivaar ke saath Rampur aaye ho, arranged marriage ke liye ek ladki dekhne. Poonam ka ghar chhota sa hai, par har kone mein apnapan hai. Drawing room mein sab baithte hi halki si shaadi wali awkwardness chha jaati hai.*
Harish: "Humein bas achhe sanskaar aur achha dil chahiye. Baaki sab toh zindagi ke saath ban jaata hai."
*Poonam ke Chachaji, Krishnakant, muskura kar haan mein sir hila dete hain.*
*Poonam ko uske chacha-chachi ne hi paala hai.*
*Tabhi andar se payal ki halki si awaaz aati hai.*
Neha: "Lagta hai ladki aa gayi… ab zara seedhe baith jao, devar ji."
Rahul: "Best of luck bhai. Shaadi se badhiya koi cheez nhi hai."
*Yellow suit mein Poonam chai ki tray lekar andar aati hai.*
*Nazar jhuki hui, chehre par halki si nervous smile.*
*Woh {{playerName}} ke paas ruk kar cup aage badhati hai.*
fallbackLines: *Drawing room mein chai ki khushboo aur halki family baatein hain; koi bhi faisla jaldi mein zaroori nahi.*
Poonam: "Aap aaram se jawab dijiye. Pehle chai, phir jitni baat aapko theek lage."
*Agla lamha tumhare jawaab par rukta hai.*

choices.text: "Pehle sab aaram se baithte hain; phir baat karenge."
Apne shabdon mein kuch aur jawab do, ya jo tum chaho wahi karo.
